from pathlib import Path
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
import json,re,subprocess,os,shlex
from snail.match import load_scratch_config,run_match,extract_object_function,parse_coff_object,object_function_fingerprint
from snail.symbols import load_function_symbol_manifest,DEFAULT_FUNCTION_SYMBOL_MANIFEST_PATH
root=Path('/Users/banteg/dev/banteg/snail-mail');manifest=load_function_symbol_manifest(DEFAULT_FUNCTION_SYMBOL_MANIFEST_PATH);out=Path('/private/tmp/snail-pch-context-control');out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
names=['draw_frontend_widget','create_golb','update_golb_ai','read_repeating_text_input_key_code','switch_track_mirror','set_snail_jetpack','load_galaxy_layout','border_mouse_test','initialize_star_field','firework_shoot','initialize_quaternion_from_matrix','sample_smtrack_heightmap']
def probe(n):
 c=load_scratch_config(root/'tools/match/scratches'/n);s=(c.directory/'scratch.cpp').read_text();inc=list(re.finditer(r'^#include[^\n]*\n',s,re.M));end=inc[-1].end();s=s[:end]+'#pragma hdrstop\n'+s[end:];p=out/n;p.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(p/'scratch.cpp').write_text(s);rows=[]
 for mode in ['normal','create','reuse']:
  flags=[]if mode=='normal'else['/Yc'if mode=='create'else'/Yu','/Fpscratch.pch']
  run=subprocess.run([str(root/'tools/match/cl.sh'),'/c',*shlex.split(c.cflags),*flags,f'/Fo{mode}.obj','scratch.cpp'],cwd=p,env={**os.environ,'MSVC_VER':c.compiler},capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30);(p/f'{mode}.log').write_text(run.stdout+run.stderr)
  if run.returncode:rows.append({'function':n,'mode':mode,'error':run.stdout+run.stderr});break
  obj=p/f'{mode}.obj';r=run_match(obj_path=obj,function_name=n,image_path=root/manifest.primary_target,manifest=manifest,symbol_name=c.symbol,end_va=c.end_va);a=r.masked_operand_audit;rows.append({'function':n,'mode':mode,'ratio':r.ratio,'prefix':r.prefix_instructions,'candidate':len(r.candidate_lines),'target':len(r.target_lines),'refs':[a.ok_count,a.unresolved_count,a.mismatch_count,a.unaudited_count],'code_sha256':object_function_fingerprint(extract_object_function(parse_coff_object(obj.read_bytes()),c.symbol or c.function))})
 print(rows,flush=True);return rows
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4)as pool:rows=list(pool.map(probe,names))
(out/'results.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))

limitations: Compares compiler emission under these two runners, not complete runner API conformance.
PCH boundary is the end of each scratch include preamble, not a recovered original precompiled header.
No new exact-function or body-byte credit.
